modules.name: Artifact selection and registry for model
modules.docstring: Artifact selection and registry for model-driven SE document generation.

modules.name: Context assembler for artifact generation
modules.docstring:
Context assembler for artifact generation.

Given an artifact template + architecture model + optional manifest,
assembles the formatted context string included in the LLM prompt.

Extracts relevant model/manifest data for each template section and
formats it concisely for LLM consumption.

functions.name: assemble_artifact_context
functions.signature: assemble_artifact_context(template: ArtifactTemplate, model: ArchitectureModel, manifest: dict | None, max_tokens: int) -> str
functions.docstring:
Assemble formatted context for artifact generation.

Returns a structured prompt string containing:
1. System prompt from template
2. For each section: heading + extracted data + instructions

Token budget is approximate (1 token ~ 4 chars). If total exceeds budget,
truncate section data (not instructions).

functions.name: format_capability_detail_context
functions.signature: format_capability_detail_context(cap_id: str, model: ArchitectureModel, manifest: dict | None) -> str
functions.docstring:
Assemble rich context for generating a per-capability API detail doc.

Extracts the full neighborhood of a single capability:
- The capability entity itself
- Realizing component(s) and their files/signatures/constants
- Related behaviors (steps, triggers, pre/postconditions)
- Exposed interfaces (endpoints, protocol)
- Applicable constraints
- Upstream/downstream relationships

Returns a structured text block suitable for LLM prompt injection.

modules.name: PlantUML diagram generation from architecture model data
modules.docstring:
PlantUML diagram generation from architecture model data.

Generates deterministic PlantUML syntax strings from model entities and
relationships. These can be embedded in documentation or rendered by any
PlantUML-compatible tool.

functions.name: generate_component_diagram
functions.docstring:
Generate a C4-style component diagram showing system structure.

Groups components by layer, renders actors, and shows
depends-on/exposes/consumes relationships.

functions.name: generate_dependency_diagram
functions.docstring:
Generate a dependency graph showing component relationships.

Simpler than C4 — plain PlantUML with rectangles and arrows.
Only includes entities that participate in at least one relationship.

functions.name: generate_sequence_diagram
functions.docstring:
Generate a sequence diagram from a behavior's steps.

Returns empty string if behavior has no steps.

functions.name: generate_nav_diagram
functions.docstring:
Generate a full-model navigational traceability diagram.

Shows ALL entities (typed shapes) and ALL relationships (labeled edges)
on a single page. Components are nested inside their layer packages.
Every node displays its ID for precise referencing by systems engineers.

functions.name: generate_focused_diagram
functions.signature: generate_focused_diagram(model: ArchitectureModel, entity_id: str, depth: int) -> str
functions.docstring:
Generate a focused subgraph centered on a specific entity.

Performs BFS from entity_id through relationships (both directions)
up to `depth` hops. Renders only the reachable subgraph with the
focus entity highlighted.

Returns empty string if entity_id is not found in the model.

functions.name: generate_all_diagrams
functions.docstring:
Generate all applicable diagrams for the model.

Returns dict mapping diagram name to PlantUML string.
Only includes diagrams where there's enough data.

modules.name: Model
modules.docstring:
Model-driven artifact selector.

Determines which SE documentation artifacts are appropriate to generate
based on the richness of an ArchitectureModel. Pure function — no I/O, no LLM calls.

functions.name: select_artifacts
functions.signature: select_artifacts(model: ArchitectureModel, manifest: dict | None, include_capability_details: bool) -> list[ArtifactSpec]
functions.docstring:
Return artifacts appropriate for this model's richness.

For each artifact in the registry, check if the model has the required entities.
Return only those artifacts whose requirements are met.
Results sorted by priority (1 first), then alphabetically by id.

If include_capability_details is True, also generates per-capability
api-detail-{cap_id} artifacts for every realized capability.

functions.name: get_artifact_spec
functions.docstring: Look up a single artifact spec by ID.

functions.name: should_decompose
functions.signature: should_decompose(model: ArchitectureModel, manifest: dict | None) -> bool
functions.docstring:
Determine if system is complex enough to warrant per-subsystem docs.

Heuristic: returns True if ANY of:
- More than 5 functional blocks (distinct source_block values on components)
- More than 50 source files in manifest
- More than 20 components

functions.name: select_subsystem_artifacts
functions.signature: select_subsystem_artifacts(subsystem: SubsystemInfo, model: ArchitectureModel, manifest: dict | None) -> list[ArtifactSpec]
functions.docstring:
Select artifacts appropriate for a subsystem (subset of system-level).

Only returns artifacts from SUBSYSTEM_ARTIFACTS that:
1. Are in the SUBSYSTEM_ARTIFACTS list
2. Have their requirements met (scoped to subsystem's components)

Returns empty list if subsystem has no components.

functions.name: select_capability_detail_artifacts
functions.docstring:
Generate one ArtifactSpec per capability for detailed API docs.

Only includes capabilities that have at least one realizing component
(via 'realizes' relationship). Each gets artifact_id = "api-detail-{cap.id}".

modules.name: Artifact template definitions
modules.docstring:
Artifact template definitions.

Each template describes HOW to generate a specific SE documentation artifact:
- What sections it has
- What model/manifest data feeds each section
- What instructions the LLM follows for each section

functions.name: get_template
functions.docstring: Look up template by artifact ID. Returns None if not found.
